newsitem.title: FRANCE: French tax on share sales will remain unchanged.
newsitem.headline: French tax on share sales will remain unchanged.

text.p: The French Finance Ministry said in a statement on Monday that corporate capital gains made through the sale of shares in other companies would remain taxed at the lower rate, which stands at 19 percent.

They would be excluded from a change in the capital gains tax which will include these gains as normal profits, to be taxed at 41.6 percent in 1997, and otherwise ends the lower tax rate regime of 19 percent.
The ministry said that the increase in corporate taxation would be applied on November 20.
It added that the tax changes would presented to parliament from September.
